links.outcome: Perceived facilitators and barriers to implementing an AI denoising PET/CT algorithm
links.effect: Focus group participants named explanations and available support such as a "local champion" as main facilitators; lack of education, workflow challenges and professional resistance were main barriers.
links.quote: The main barriers to implement this algorithm included workflow challenges, resistance from professionals and lack of education; while the main facilitators were explanations and the availability of support to ask questions such as a "local champion".

screen.reason: Qualitative empirical study (focus groups with nuclear medicine technologists) evaluating barriers and facilitators to implementing an AI denoising algorithm into clinical workflow.
